_comment: Human-editable deal source. The Decap portal at /admin edits THIS file. scripts/build-promotions.mjs expands it into data/promotions.json, which the site reads. Do not edit promotions.json by hand.

deals.headline: SammyC's Skool is Live
deals.description: SammyC's Skool community is now live. Get direct access to Sam, research peptide modules, vendor intel, and community discussion.

deals.headline: 20% off first order with NEWCOFFEE20, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: New to Coffee and Peppers? Code NEWCOFFEE20 takes 20% off your first order, and SAMMYC stacks another 15% on top at checkout.

deals.headline: 25% off for military and first responders
deals.description: Solyn Labs offers 25% off for verified military and first responders, and code SAMMYC stacks on top. Eligibility and verification are handled by the vendor, so the prices shown here reflect the standing SAMMYC discount only. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 20% off for veterans and first responders
deals.description: Orbitrex Peptides offers 20% off for verified veterans and first responders. Code SAMMYC applies 15% off for everyone else. Eligibility and verification are handled by the vendor. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 50% off sitewide automatically, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: LabSourced Peptides is running 50% off sitewide, applied automatically with no code needed. Bulk pricing is back on top of it, 20% off any order over 20 vials, 10% off kits, 5% off five packs and 3% off three packs. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 10% off, paying with Zelle takes a further 5% off, and loyalty rewards add 5% back. Shipping is free on orders over $150. No end date has been announced, so confirm the sale is still live and check final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 20% off sitewide, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Disguised Alpha is running 20% off sitewide, and code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 10% off the reduced price. No end date has been announced, so confirm the sale is still live and check final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 45% off sitewide automatically, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Glow Aminos is running 45% off sitewide from September 18 through 11:59pm Eastern on September 30. The discount applies automatically, no code needed. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price, and paying with Zelle takes a further 5% off. Shipping is free on orders over $150. HBrand BAC water and merchandise are excluded from the sale. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: 45% off sitewide automatically, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Flawless Compounds is running 45% off sitewide from September 18 through 11:59pm Eastern on September 30. The discount applies automatically, no code needed. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price, and paying with Zelle takes a further 5% off. Shipping is free on orders over $150. HBrand BAC water and merchandise are excluded from the sale. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Flash Sale Friday, 15% off sitewide every Friday, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Aurora Peptides runs Flash Sale Friday every Friday. The sale is 15% off sitewide, excluding brand goods, and it is only valid on Fridays. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 20% off. Because the sale runs one day a week, the prices shown here do not include the 15% and reflect the code only. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Build your own kit, 5% off 5 vials or 15% off 10, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Coffee and Peppers lets you build your own kit from any combination of eligible single vials, with the discount applied automatically at checkout. A half kit of 5 vials saves 5% and a full kit of 10 vials saves 15%. Original product names are kept on every vial. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price. The saving depends on kit size, so the per unit prices shown here do not include it. This offer has no end date. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Fall Into Research, SAMMYC boosted to 30% off
deals.description: Mile High Compounds is running its Fall Into Research sale from 8:00am Mountain on Monday September 21 through 11:59pm Mountain on Monday September 28. Code SAMMYC is boosted from 10% to 30% off for the sale period, which the vendor states is a better rate than the standard site discount running during the sale. The code is the offer rather than an addition to that discount. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Weekend sale, 30% off sitewide, stacks with SAMMYC
deals.description: Ion Peptide is running 30% off sitewide from Friday morning September 25 through midnight Monday September 28. The discount applies automatically, no code needed. Code SAMMYC stacks for an additional 15% off the reduced price, and paying by ACH takes a further 5% off. Orders over $250 are entered into the vendor's giveaway draws. Confirm final pricing at checkout.

deals.headline: Autumn Arc Sale, 20% off your order with code ARC20
deals.description: Orbitrex Peptides is running its Autumn Arc Sale through 11:59pm Central on Sunday September 27. Code ARC20 takes 20% off the entire order across the full catalog, with no minimum. The vendor did not say whether code SAMMYC stacks on top of ARC20, so try it at checkout and confirm final pricing there.
